advisories.summary: Enables Starknet 0.14.4. RPC websocket clients must answer server pings. The keepalive cannot be turned off.
advisories.action: Make websocket clients answer pings. Do not set --rpc.websocket.ping-interval, --rpc.websocket.initial-frame-timeout, or --rpc.websocket.max-missed-pings to 0. Raise the ping interval instead.
